A few things.

1. The DTide format is changing again and I'll have to re-interpret the new format and what players are doing.

2. I do plan on doing a very big deep dive into the data,, but that will be in a few weeks. So the plan will be to have one Mega report that has a lot of information, but it will take a lot of time to make.

i'm close to finishing a dtide analysis tool that's pretty similar with comprehensive usage coverage, but all I have thought of is for enlightenment tiers, stage, and unit filters for now. don't know if I should incorporate any wheel data or what but it will be able to look into this current rotation before the format changes again lol
oh right and borrowing rate is an interesting one
but beyond the visualization i'm too lazy to extract the actual insights out of it
